We’re happy to share our new manuscript, “Gradient-Based Optimization of Force Field Parameters for Martini Lipid Models.” This work demonstrates how modern gradient-based methods can substantially accelerate the refinement of coarse-grained (CG) force-field parameters within the Martini framework.

We invite you to check it out [here](https://doi.org/10.26434/chemrxiv-2025-dtt4k)!🚀
